title: The Ear
writer: Karel Kachyna, Jan Procházka, Ladislav Winkelhöfer
actors: Jirina Bohdalová, Radoslav Brzobohatý, Gustav Opocenský
plot: After coming home from a Party gathering one night, a Czech official becomes convinced that he is about to be the subject of a political purge and tries to do damage control, while also dealing with his turbulent marriage.
